methods.primary_unit: same GT x current frame; >=2 available windows
methods.clean: wholly in frame and no overlapping GT boxes
methods.strict: clean plus no matching ambiguity in ANY available context
methods.boundary: same GT frame with both slot 0..3 or36..39 and interior4..35; each side center-nearest, tie lower start
methods.components: 8-connected components >=threshold from saved NPZ; subtract all-GT one-to-one matches from existing CSV; unmatched is not confirmed false-positive
limitations: four prescreened clips; sequence is not necessarily independent scene
adjacent GT frames correlated; no framewise significance
processed and source IDs are annotation labels; source IDs may be category-specific or reused; their counts do not confirm physical object identity or fragmentation
all-context negative is finite-window diagnosis, not an oracle deployed metric
category mapping from annotation only; visibility not fully audited
original is max-fused prediction and differs in component merging, included only supplementary
